name: bg-page-turn
title: Page-Turn Background — line-sweep page change (hard cut)
description: One-shot background: 2-3 full-bleed photos changed by an invisible line sweeping across — behind the line the next page is already there, ahead of it the old page, hard cut at the boundary, no page-back effect. Landscape sweeps left-to-right, portrait top-to-bottom. Sweeps span scene_dur, then the last page holds still. Landscape 16:9 twin of bg-page-turn-portrait.

variables.label: Pages
variables.description: 2-3 page images separated by ";" (URL or project asset path), revealed in order

variables.label: Direction
variables.description: Sweep origin: auto = landscape left-to-right / portrait top-to-bottom

variables.label: Scrim
variables.description: Black overlay strength for text readability 0-1

variables.label: Scene duration
variables.description: Plan to cut around this length; sweeps span it (5-60), remainder holds the last page
